title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Perfect-gas conservative state and nondimensional inputs exist; results suffer first-order and inaccurate viscous approximations.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: cgns_reader.cpp first zone handles TRI_3/QUAD_4 and boundary edges; face_geometry.cpp computes global Green-theorem volumes; multi-zone unsupported and local geometry is placeholder.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: fvm_solver.cpp:99–159 applies equal/opposite interior flux and boundary flux, but first-order states and limited validation restrict credit.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: fvm_solver.cpp:175–212 implements local Lax-Friedrichs/Rusanov; entropy treatment is its diffusive form.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: farfield, reflected slip and negated-velocity no-slip branches are present; simplified wall flux limits accuracy.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: fvm_solver.cpp:109–114 uses cell averages directly; report discloses first-order-only.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: No reconstruction limiter; nonpositive updated cells are reset to freestream rather than reconstructed-state positivity preservation.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: fvm_solver.cpp:215–256 omits cell distance in gradients; :513–521 approximates shear as mu times speed without wall distance/sign.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: CFL-ramped local diagonal updates exist, but inner iterations reuse a frozen residual and no coupled linear convergence is shown.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: solve dispatches steady solve; report admits BDF2 pending, and Re200 rows after step 7124 were copied without solving.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS is linked but no partition call, rank-local distributed solve, halo or global reduction is implemented.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
